models.title: Covered call maximum gain
models.summary: Maximum gain on a covered call as appreciation to the strike plus the call premium (negative when written in the money).

relationship.locator: PDF: LM1 covered calls, printed pp. 16-18 (PDF pp. 24-26): Maximum gain = (X-S0)+c0; worked gain 1.16+1.44 = 2.60; in-text Q1 answer (30.00-25.00)+1.55 = 6.55; ITM example -(50-45)+7 = 2; breakeven S0-c0 with 15.84-1.44 = 14.40
relationship.translation_notes: Decimals. The PDF's ITM example subtracts depreciation, which is the same signed form.

assumptions: European-style exercise at expiration; long stock plus one short call, same expiry.
limitations: Maximum only; profit below the strike is lower; transaction costs ignored.

models.title: Bull call spread breakeven
models.summary: Breakeven underlying price for a call bull spread as the lower strike plus the net cost of the spread.

relationship.locator: PDF: LM1 bull spreads, printed pp. 33-34 (PDF pp. 41-42), Exhibit 17: Alternative 1 (buy SEP 15 at 1.64, write SEP 17 at 0.51): cost 1.13, max profit 0.87, breakeven 16.13; Alternative 2 (buy SEP 16 at 0.97, write SEP 17 at 0.51): max profit 0.54, max loss 0.46, breakeven 16.46
relationship.translation_notes: Decimals. XL < XH; cL > cH so the spread has positive cost.
